label: Sun-dried cheese
note: Not pressed and not ripened: it is dried in the open air until hard and stored dry.

about.text: Cheese set with rennet and dried hard in the sun instead of being pressed and ripened, so it keeps through the dry season. Best documented is tchoukou of Niger, made by Fulani, Hausa and Tuareg women from raw cow's or goat's milk.

how.text: Tchoukou is the Hausa and Fulani name, tikomart the Tamasheq. One process was found across all villages surveyed around Zinder. The same sun-drying is used for Klila in Morocco, Gapal in Burkina Faso and Gashi in Mali (Seini et al. 2018).

steps.name: prepare rennet
steps.note: Dried calf rennet steeped in water with ginger, hot pepper, garlic or onion, Guinea pepper, and millet and cowpea grain.
In the open air, on mats of Deverra scoparia stalks.
